from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyFixedAsset(BaseModel):
    """Captures the Fixed Assets information for a single company found in one financial report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the company whose report is being analyzed")
    account_item: str | None = Field(description="Name of the specific financial item, e.g. '固定资产'")
    amount: float | None = Field(description="The reported amount for the financial item")
    currency: str | None = Field(description="Currency of the amount, e.g. 'RMB'")
    reporting_period: str | None = Field(description="Time period covered by the report, e.g. '2024 Q1'")
    financial_statement_section: str | None = Field(description="Section where the value is located, e.g. 'Consolidated Balance Sheet'")
    verbatim_quote: str = Field(description="Short verbatim text containing the value for grounding")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_fixed_assets: list[CompanyFixedAsset]
